title: casselia glaziovii
intro: Casselia glaziovii, commonly known as Brazilian angelica, is a plant species belonging to the Rutaceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions due to its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Casselia glaziovii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral effects. The plant's therapeutic actions include wound healing, antimicrobial activity, and the potential treatment of various diseases, including cancer and diabetes.
